text:
Silver Price in 1968
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1968, the LBMA silver price fell 0.7% between 1968-01-31 ($1.96) and 1968-12-31 ($1.95). The highest sampled price was $2.50 in June and the lowest was $1.93 in October. The mean of these observations was $2.19. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
